choices.title: AI Journey Guide
choices.enables: Accessible route alternatives from verified information.
choices.strengthen: Verified obstruction updates and offline accessible guidance.
choices.limits: Does not create a physically accessible route.

choices.title: Connected Streetscape
choices.enables: Accessible route, crossings and rest points within an improved area.
choices.strengthen: An inspected alternate accessible route and physical signage.
choices.limits: Cannot guarantee the route remains unobstructed.

choices.title: Mobility Network
choices.enables: Request for accessible transport and pickup assistance.
choices.strengthen: Confirmed booking, usable pickup and true backup arrangements.
choices.limits: Cannot invent accessible vehicles or drivers.

choices.title: Community Care Pod
choices.enables: Accessible private consultation point and selected supported measurements.
choices.strengthen: Verified equipment, privacy, staffed connection and care fallback.
choices.limits: Pod access never guarantees qualified clinical acceptance.

choices.title: Distributed Care Network
choices.enables: Identification and referral to nearby participating qualified care.
choices.strengthen: Verified information, accepted referral and contingency pathway.
choices.limits: Cannot create clinician capacity or eligibility.

choices.title: Mobile Care Services
choices.enables: Request appropriate mobile assessment at Arthur's location.
choices.strengthen: Confirmed service, clinician/equipment match and transfer alternative.
choices.limits: Cannot manufacture a staffed mobile care service.

choices.title: Adaptive Walking Coach
choices.enables: Personalized encouragement and pacing within approved activity limits.
choices.strengthen: Verified goals, rest/stop cues and offline approved guidance.
choices.limits: Cannot diagnose new symptoms or prescribe a different activity plan.

choices.title: Personal Health Companion
choices.enables: Arthur's reported concerns, preferences and verified plan organized for review.
choices.strengthen: Source checking, uncertainty warning and accepted qualified-advice route.
choices.limits: Cannot infer new clinical authority from an earlier chapter.

choices.title: Connected Participation
choices.enables: Accessible participation channels where a community activity offers them.
choices.strengthen: Confirmed alternative arrangements and tested access.
choices.limits: Remote participation is not always equivalent to Arthur's desired visit.

choices.title: Autonomous Delivery
choices.enables: Eligible essentials delivery by a real approved service.
choices.strengthen: Valid delivery coverage, secure handoff and nonrobotic fallback.
choices.limits: Delivery cannot solve mobility barriers or medical concerns.

choices.title: Connected Community Hub
choices.enables: Accessible venue with up-to-date activity information.
choices.strengthen: Verified alternative staffed accessible venue and relocation plan.
choices.limits: Cannot create an alternate booked venue.

choices.title: Community Concierge
choices.enables: Human/AI support that requests and coordinates services.
choices.strengthen: Assigned ownership, accepted requests and backup coverage.
choices.limits: Cannot create transport, venue or clinical capacity.
